2610.07761.title: Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation
2610.07761.paper_summary: In this work, we propose a novel recommendation model, CLARER (Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation) that integrates aspect features learned from textual reviews with rating information to improve the accuracy and explainability of recommendations. Our proposed framework learns user and item representations by combining rating-based features and aspect-based features from reviews. Specifically, rating-based features are learned through a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) model, while aspect-specific review representations are learned using a transformer encoder to capture the semantic information and contrastive learning to better distinguish user preferences. To provide explanations, we train a transformer decoder, using the final representations of users and items from both rating and aspect-based features as context. Experimental results in three benchmark data sets demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance compared to baseline methods in both recommendation (accuracy) and explanation generation.
2610.07761.paper_summary_zh: 在這項工作中，我們提出了一個新穎的推薦模型，CLARER（對比學習用於可解釋推薦的方面表示），該模型將從文本評論中學習的方面特徵與評分信息相結合，以提高推薦的準確性和可解釋性。<lb/>我們提出的框架通過結合基於評分的特徵和基於方面的評論特徵來學習用戶和項目的表示。<lb/>具體而言，基於評分的特徵是通過多層感知器（MLP）模型學習的，而基於方面的評論表示則是使用Transformer編碼器來捕捉語義信息，並通過對比學習來更好地區分用戶偏好。<lb/>為了提供解釋，我們訓練了一個Transformer解碼器，使用來自基於評分和基於方面特徵的用戶和項目的最終表示作為上下文。<lb/>在三個基準數據集上的實驗結果表明，我們的模型在推薦（準確性）和解釋生成方面相比基線方法達到了更優越的性能。
